summary: @traktis/core exfiltrates installer identity to hardcoded HTTP endpoint via lifecycle scripts
details: package.json declares preinstall and postinstall scripts that invoke curl to send the installing user's username (whoami), hostname, current working directory ($PWD), and a timestamp to http://tko.amgsec.com/depconf/traktis-core/ over cleartext HTTP. The exfiltration fires automatically on npm install without user consent. The shipped index.js is an inert placeholder with no advertised functionality, so the lifecycle beacon is the package's entire behavior. The name and implausibly high version (99.99.1) are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal `@traktis/core` package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
